notes: Facts confirmed 2026-09-10 from the church's own site. Address is 3255 N Campbell Ave, Tucson AZ 85719. LEADERSHIP CHANGED: the leadership page now lists Rev. Alma Aguirre-Olivares as Pastor, and a 7 July 2026 sermon post welcomes her as 'our new pastor' (her bio had not been posted yet). The previously seeded name, Rev. Mel Roberts, is the University of Arizona campus pastor and appears in the archive as a guest preacher (e.g. 'Bizarre Bible: Eutychus', 1 July 2026), not as the appointed pastor - he was removed from pastors[] for that reason. UMC clergy are reappointed regularly, so re-check the appointment each year. Sermon video is on YouTube (@stjamestucson) and Facebook live streams, with an index at /worship/. Separate oddity to be aware of: St. Paul's UMC Tucson carries a 'St. James UMC' page under its /locations/ section, so the two congregations have some shared arrangement; they remain separate records here. Coordinates still need tools/geocode.py.
